crossRefs.note: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

translations.web: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
translations.bsb: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
translations.kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
translations.asv: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burden.
